# Static Savvy Media

> Static Savvy Media (SSM) is a digital marketing agency headquartered in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India, with a Malaysia office in Rawang, Selangor, serving Kuala Lumpur and the Klang Valley. We provide SEO, local SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation, GEO/AEO (AI search optimisation), website design and development, social media marketing, Google Ads and AI business automation for small and medium businesses in Tamil Nadu, Malaysia and beyond.

## Key facts
- Brand: Static Savvy Media (SSM)
- Website: https://www.staticsavvymedia.com/
- Founded: 1 October 2021 in Madurai by Deepan Kanz (founder; https://www.staticsavvymedia.com/about/deepan-kanz/, https://www.linkedin.com/in/deepankanz/)
- Head office (HQ, India): 2nd Floor, 4/3, Srinivasa Perumal Koil St, Kamarajar Salai, Madurai, Tamil Nadu 625009, India. Phone/WhatsApp: +91 99440 40345
- Thoothukudi office (India): 90, Peria Kadai St, Matha Koil, Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu 628001, India. Phone/WhatsApp: +91 99440 40345
- Malaysia office: NO.9, Jalan Anggun 2J, Taman Anggun 2, 48000 Rawang, Selangor, Malaysia (near AEON Mall Rawang), serving Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, Petaling Jaya, Shah Alam and Klang. Call: +60 12-453 7030. WhatsApp: +91 99440 40345. Hours: Mon–Fri, 9 AM – 6 PM (MYT)
- Email: info@staticsavvymedia.com
- Google rating: 4.9★ from 106 Google reviews (Madurai Google Business Profile)
- Markets: Madurai and Tamil Nadu (HQ market), Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, Rawang), plus Singapore and Dubai served remotely
- Monthly retainers with no minimum contract term; every plan is quoted after a free review (WhatsApp +91 99440 40345; Malaysia calls +60 12-453 7030)
